review.name: Turtle Duck
findings: Original source all twelve head/body raw slices and all 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected. Lower beak and side jaw stretch during head turns, recoil and defeat. Broadened the lower face skin binding to the complete head. Accepted candidate twelve raw slices and all 216 native actual-technique frames inspected; beak, bandana, shell, wings and both legs remain coherent. Frozen independent landmarks and 468 blends pass; 203 full-geometry poses have zero warnings. Final rebuilt battle repeat review pending.

Final separate second pass actually inspected 24 raw source/battle head/body slices, all 32 low/medium production transition slices, 24 advancing idle frames, all 216 actual technique frames in twelve native strips and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. First reduced candidate had insufficient side-jaw coverage (17 vertices); retain the original independently frozen 77-vertex source patch during simplification, without changing any landmark or threshold. Both rebuilt assets pass 469 frozen face poses and 468 blends, 203 full-geometry poses with zero warnings. All original animation curves, sculpt, textures and rig preserved, with 21413 protected vertex palettes unchanged. Eight focused regressions/animation-bank tests and production build pass. Whole-roster and live release pending.
